question: What mantra phrase is uttered next in the Caṇḍeśa ritual sequence?
premises: A formula is introduced by saying thus
The deity is addressed as holding an axe in hand
The word dhīmahi is then given
inference: Having said thus, one should then utter the word 'dhīmahi' to the one who holds an axe in his hand.
plain_english: Having said this, he should then utter the word 'dhīmahi' to the deity who holds an axe in his hand.
